sentences.text: For Petitioner : Mr.A.Raja Mohideen  For Respondents : Mr.J.Ashok for R2 to R5  Additional Government Pleader  Mr.N.Mohideen Basha for R1  ORDER (Order of the Court was made by M.S.RAMESH,J.)

This writ petition has been filed for a mandamus directing the respondents Nos.1 to 3 to direct the III Sub Court, Madurai to complete the proceedings of pending Land Acquisition Enhancement of Compensation cases LAOP Nos.251/2019, 261/2019, 266/2019, 267/2019, 268/2019, 325/2022, 326/2022 and 328/2022 and similar cases https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis within stipulated time and consequently direct the respondent Nos.4 and 5 to send the Enhancement of Compensation Reference Cases for adjudication to the Principal District Judge, Madurai under Section 53 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 r/w G.O.Ms.No.305 Revenue and Disaster Management LA1(1) dated 20.09.2027
by considering the petitioner's representation dated 08.10.2024 within the period stipulated by this Court.
2. The prayer in the writ petition is two fold.
In the first part of the prayer, the petitioner seeks for a direction to the respondents to direct the Sub Court to complete the LAOP proceedings.
Such an authority is not vested with the respondents herein to direct the Court to complete the proceedings and therefore, the first portion of the prayer is not feasible for consideration.
3. In the second portion of the prayer, the petitioner has sought for reference of the cases from the respondents 4 and 5 to the Principal District Judge.

The learned Additional Government Pleader, on https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis instructions, submitted that all the LAOP cases have already been referred to the Principal District Judge concerned on 25.03.2019 itself.
As such, no effective orders can be passed to the second part of the prayer sought for.
Accordingly, the writ petition stands closed.
No costs.
